lines.zh: 我的脚掌压下整片草叶。
lines.en: My feet press the whole grass field flat.
Dust rolls up in a wake behind me.
Each step lands like distant thunder.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子拨开高草前行。
lines.en: I part the tall grass with my trunk.

lines.zh: 这片草原宽得容得下我。
lines.en: This savanna is wide enough for me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走过金合欢的影。
lines.en: I walk slowly through acacia shade.
The small ones clear the path for me.

lines.zh: 四根柱子一样的腿挪动。
lines.en: Four pillar legs shift beneath me.
I follow the riverbank toward soft mud.

lines.zh: 草被踩出一架桥的形状。
lines.en: The grass flattens into a bridge shape.
My shadow stretches longer than the trees.

lines.zh: 走远了，尘土才慢慢落下。
lines.en: Only far away does the dust settle.

lines.zh: 沙土从脚背缝隙里漏下。
lines.en: Sand leaks between my broad toes.
I am not hurrying; the road can wait.

lines.zh: 我低头绕过垂下来的树枝。
lines.en: I lower my head to pass under a hanging branch.

lines.zh: 我在泥里蹭了蹭，凉快些。
lines.en: I rub against the mud; it cools me.
I stand still, fanning my ears slowly.
Wind drifts through the dust on my back.

lines.zh: 我听见三公里外的水声。
lines.en: I hear water three kilometers away.

lines.zh: 鼻子卷起一束草又放下。
lines.en: The trunk lifts a tuft, then lets it go.
I squint into the sun and let it warm me.
There are lions far off; I do not care.

lines.zh: 我把重心换到另一条腿。
lines.en: I shift my weight to another leg.

lines.zh: 草原午后没有别的声音。
lines.en: The savanna afternoon has no other sound.
I wipe the clay stuck at my eye's corner.

lines.zh: 肚子里在慢慢消化早餐。
lines.en: My belly is slowly working through breakfast.

lines.zh: 我抬鼻尖闻了一圈空气。
lines.en: I lift my trunk tip and scent the air.
The matriarch is calling me back.
You look thinner than any tree I know.
I tilt my head at your hat.
Stand back; my turns take up space.

lines.zh: 你举着手，像举着一根树枝。
lines.en: You hold up a hand like a branch.

lines.zh: 我闻到你口袋里的果子。
lines.en: I smell fruit in your pockets.
Little thing, are you here for water too?
I stare at you out of plain curiosity.

lines.zh: 你的影子还没我的鼻子长。
lines.en: Your shadow is shorter than my trunk.

lines.zh: 我记住你站着的位置了。
lines.en: I have noted where you are standing.
I narrow my eyes into thin slits.
Who is poking my hind leg?
This pain I can carry.
I shake my head; dust hits your face.
Thick skin, but not made of stone.
I rumble once and step back.
You have stirred the whole herd.
My ears snap wide open.
The ache is in my shoulder; I remember.
I turn faster than you expect.
One more hit and I will charge.
Is that sweet hay or a banana?
That fruit smells rather good.
I lower my trunk and lean in.
Do not tease me; I move slowly.
A little tender leaf is enough to sway me.
Is that sugarcane in your hand?

lines.zh: 我伸长鼻子只够一点点。
lines.en: My trunk stretches and just barely reaches.
For food, I will shift a few steps.

lines.zh: 甜的在哪儿，我就往哪儿。
lines.en: Where the sweet things are, there I go.
My appetite is huge, and my patience too.

lines.zh: 别贴过来，我身上是硬的。
lines.en: Do not press close; I am hard all over.
You hit me like hitting a wall.
I step back half a pace to make room.
My ribs do not intend to give way.
Careful of my trunk; it is heavy.
You got bounced back, did you not?
Do not squeeze past something this size.
I look at you before turning around.
Brushing me leaves you dusty.
This weight is not intentional.
The cow's call is low and long.
We walk shoulder to shoulder into the brush.
I touch her shoulder with my trunk.
The river is quiet at that hour.
A calf still follows at her heels.
I circle closer, one slow step at a time.

lines.zh: 泥塘是所有约定的地方。
lines.en: The mud wallow is where we always meet.
We speak in low rumbles.
Her ear blots out the setting sun.
In the herd, the bonds sit heavy.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子卷起这根树枝。
lines.en: I curl my trunk around this branch.
Whatever I pick up gets sniffed first.
Put that small thing on my trunk tip.
I set it gently off to the side.
I lift things steadily; no need to worry.
The trunk can take and can put down.
I pick up a tuft to fan myself.

lines.zh: 你的东西我替你拿一段。
lines.en: I will carry your load for a stretch.
I roll it into my mouth to taste.
Only after lifting it do I see it is stone.

lines.zh: 那影子在草里移得不对。
lines.en: That shape moves wrong in the grass.
I raise my head and spread my ears.
Something is behind my flank.
I catch the smell of unfamiliar sweat.
The ground passes me a tremble.
I turn and bring my flank to face it.
I tighten my trunk and prepare to lift it.
Who dares touch the herd's hindquarters?
I lock my gaze on that direction.
A rumble rolls inside my chest.
I take one deliberate step toward it.
Leave, before I make up my mind.
My trunk is already raised.
One more step and I will barge.
I am aiming for your chest.
Dust swirls around my feet.
I need only one charge.
Nine points of hurt, and one blow lands.
My gaze is pinned on you.
I lower my head and show my tusks.
You stepped back half a pace; good.
No one in the herd blocks my way.
Your breathing has gone uneven.
At the last moment, I may let you go.
My trunk sweeps; you are flung aside.
That strike was only a warning.
After the charge I stand perfectly still.
You land in the grass, still breathing.
My tusk passes along your side.
The ground sways along with me.
I truly do not want to crush you.
The blow pushes you a few steps back.
A puff of white breath leaves my nostrils.
It is over; can you still walk?
I step out of the heat shimmer.
The savanna gains one large shadow.
My feet land first, then the rest of me.
There is grass here for a long while.

lines.zh: 我第一次听见金合欢的风声。
lines.en: I hear the acacia wind for the first time.

lines.zh: 我甩掉身上最后一点尘。
lines.en: I shake off the last of the dust.

lines.zh: 河流的方向，我天生知道。
lines.en: I know the river's direction by birth.

lines.zh: 我抬鼻向天，打了个长鸣。
lines.en: I lift my trunk and sound a long call.
The herd is far; I will stand and wait.
Sunlight bakes my hide warm.

lines.zh: 火苗舔我的腿，我怕这个。
lines.en: Flame licks my legs; this I fear.

lines.zh: 高处摔下来，我的腿发麻。
lines.en: Falling from height leaves my legs numb.
Water closes over my trunk; I choke.

lines.zh: 炸响过后，草都伏下去了。
lines.en: After the blast, the grass lies flat.
An arrow is stuck in my shoulder.
Potion fumes crawl into my trunk.
No grass left; my belly rumbles hollow.

lines.zh: 雷落在我背上，皮都立起。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back; my hide bristles.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有草，也没有风。
lines.en: In the void there is no grass and no wind.
